reference_row.note: training-support fit on 675 columns; not an independent dataset

metric: local delta = (mean_quality[to]-mean_quality[from])*25000 on the evaluated version set; amp20_scaled applies one global least-squares scale first; level = mean_quality[v435]*25000 vs online attention target; held-out = v441..444 vs v435
limits: Only edges whose both endpoints are inside the 33-version evaluation set are scored; datasets with few test cases give a coarse mean_quality. Level match and delta geometry are separate claims and neither alone proves online transfer.
